scenes.title: Buying one? Check these 5 things first.
Check where nobody cleans.
scenes.body: Around the sunroof, under the tail-lights, door hinges, rear spring perches, the windscreen seal.

scenes.title: Engage all three.
scenes.body: Centre, rear, then front, on loose ground. Lockers that were never used often don't work.

scenes.title: Hold it at 55–70 mph.
scenes.body: Judder can mean a failing propshaft. Harsh 2–3 shifts point to old fluid or the conductor plate.

scenes.title: 2002–04: electrical gremlins.
scenes.body: Seat motors, window regulators, door locks, transfer-case actuators. Better by 2005–06.

scenes.title: Look underneath for oil.
scenes.body: The oil filter housing gasket leak was my biggest issue. Cheap to fix; it just takes time.

scenes.title: Plus a printable checklist.
scenes.body: Free at boxytrucks.com. Link in bio.
